summary: Full login flow E2E testing for GymFichaje Angular 18 PWA (Supabase Auth). All 8 test scenarios passed after frontend restart to clear 504 chunk cache errors.

test_results.admin_login_redirects_to_admin_users: ✅ PASS — demo Admin button fills form, auto-submits, redirects to /admin/users
test_results.admin_sidebar_3_nav_items: ✅ PASS — nav-users (Empleados), nav-reports (Informes), nav-settings (Configuración) all visible
test_results.employee_login_redirects_to_dashboard: ✅ PASS — demo Empleado button fills form, auto-submits, redirects to /employee/dashboard
test_results.employee_dashboard_clock_and_fichar_butt: ✅ PASS — current-time clock and FICHAR ENTRADA button visible (María García)
test_results.logout_redirects_to_login: ✅ PASS — 'Cerrar sesión' button works, redirects to /login
test_results.wrong_credentials_show_spanish_error: ✅ PASS — 'Email o contraseña incorrectos.' shown in Spanish
test_results.admin_reports_page_loads: ✅ PASS — /admin/reports shows 'Informes' title and period selector
test_results.unauthenticated_admin_reports_redirects_: ✅ PASS — direct navigation to /admin/reports redirects to /login

notes: Frontend had 504 Outdated Optimize Dep errors on first run due to stale chunk cache. Restarting frontend via supervisorctl resolved it. The issue is transient/dev-server related, not a code bug.
critical_code_review_comments: fillDemo() auto-submits after 150ms setTimeout — this is intentional but could cause issues if credentials are wrong (no manual review step). Acceptable for demo UX.
authGuard checks currentUser() synchronously — if APP_INITIALIZER hasn't resolved yet on cold start, guard could incorrectly block. Should check isLoading() state too.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Angular 18 PWA fully serverless via Supabase. Login flows for admin and employee work correctly. Admin panel shows employee list (3 users: Administrador, María García, Test User inactive). Employee dashboard shows clock and FICHAR ENTRADA button. All guards working. If 504 chunk errors appear again, restart frontend with supervisorctl.
